actual.descripcion: Genesis Championship, Second Round | Round 2 of the 2026 Genesis Championship continues at the prestigious Woo Jeong Hills Country Club in Cheonan-si, South Korea. Round 2 concludes with the traditional 36-hole cut. Only the top 65 players and ties advance to the weekend rounds.
